messages:
ria: Heads-up — quarterly access attestation kicks off tomorrow. Need quick owner handoffs for ownerless service accounts, KMS keys, and any dangling admin IAM bindings. I sketched a small runbook below, please ack and add owners.

 tom: ack. Can you paste the queries you want us to run? I'll run in staging first.

 maya: on it. I'll run an ownerless svcacct report tonight and push CSV to GCS. Quick commands i use: 

 ```
 # GCP service accounts (flattened csv)
 gcloud iam service-accounts list --format='json' | jq -r '.[] | [.email, .displayName] | @csv'

 # Find owner-role bindings in a project
 gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner"))'

 # KMS key policy check (GCP)
 gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY_NAME --keyring=KR --location=global --format=json

 # AWS quick list (example)
 aws kms list-keys --profile prod --output text | awk '{print $NF}' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-policy --key-id {} --profile prod
 ```

 devon: propose policy: if no owner assigned within 7 days -> temporary disable console/API access and tag resource `orphaned:under-review`. Rotate or disable keys where possible. If still no owner after 30 days -> SRE rotates creds and archives the resource. This avoids accidental permanent deletes. :thumbsup:

 access-bot: attestation-bot: run_started ts=1769992468 scope=org scan=ownerless-resources

 maya: uploaded CSV -> gs://redwood-security/attest/1769992468-ownerless.csv  (12 items). I'll share sample rows: svcacct-analytics@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com, no owner; kms-04a8 key, team: none.

 tom: assigned owners in the spreadsheet: svcacct-analytics -> @devon, kms-04a8 -> @maya. I'll open a PR to update the entitlement ledger and add remediation labels.

 ria: nice. I'll draft the owner-handoff email and include the self-attest form link + timeline (7d temp deactivation, 30d archive). tagging @legal to confirm archival language. :eyes:

 devon: legal gave verbal nod on archival but asked us to keep backups for retention team. i'll sync with retention and add a note in the runbook.

 ops-bot: attestation-bot: run_complete status=partial_orphans=12 duration=00:07:20 report=gs://redwood-security/attest/1769992468-report.json

 ria: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) @tom open PR for ledger changes (2) @maya add remediation steps and example playbooks to runbook (3) i'll schedule a 30-min retro if >10 ownerless items next quarter. :calendar:
